items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Mark Warner I never worked for

ctx.x: But you never called him Mark, did you, or you never called him Warner.
Oh, no, his name wasn't Mark. Mark Warner I never worked for -- but he had the job, anyway; we used to call Raymond Scott, his tuxedo in his brother's orchestra. But that's just a bit of trivia.

Well, it's nice to mention that because down through the years, these two gentlemen did so much for music, especially popular music, American popular music, and there hasn't been enough written about American popular
